description: Source code implementing block source abstractions for reading data from buffers and files, including functions for releasing, closing, reading, and sizing block data, as well as creating block sources from buffers and files.

classes.name: struct reftable_block_source
classes.description: Structure representing a block source with function pointers for operations.

classes.name: struct reftable_buf
classes.description: Structure representing an in-memory buffer used as a block source.

classes.name: struct file_block_source
classes.description: Structure representing a file-based block source with size and data pointer.

methods.name: block_source_release_data
methods.description: Releases data associated with a block source.

methods.name: block_source_close
methods.description: Closes a block source, releasing resources.

methods.name: block_source_read_data
methods.description: Reads data from a block source at a specified offset.

methods.name: block_source_size
methods.description: Returns the size of a block source.

methods.name: reftable_buf_release_data
methods.description: Releases data in a buffer block source, filling with 0xff before freeing.

methods.name: reftable_buf_close
methods.description: No-op close function for buffer block source.

methods.name: reftable_buf_read_data
methods.description: Reads data from a buffer block source at a specified offset.

methods.name: reftable_buf_size
methods.description: Returns the size of a buffer block source.

methods.name: block_source_from_buf
methods.description: Initializes a block source from a buffer.

methods.name: reftable_block_source_from_file
methods.description: Creates a block source from a file given its filename.
